title: Interview: John Lennon and Yoko Ono for Weekend World | 1973
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono gave an interview to the UK television show Weekend World on 6 April 1973.

The interview took place in Los Angeles, and was conducted by reporter John Fielding. The discussion covered a range of subjects, including the end of Lennon’s business partnership with Allen Klein, Paul McCartney’s recent drug bust in Scotland, and Lennon’s attempts to remain living in the US. It was broadcast on 8 April from 11.30am by London Weekend Television on the ITV network.
